props.name: title
props.description: The title of the alert dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: The content/message of the alert dialog.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The trigger element that opens the dialog.

props.name: variant
props.description: The variant of the alert dialog.

props.name: primaryActionLabel
props.description: Label for the primary action button.

props.name: secondaryActionLabel
props.description: Label for the secondary action button.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Label for the cancel button.

props.name: onPrimaryAction
props.description: Handler called when the primary action is triggered.

props.name: onSecondaryAction
props.description: Handler called when the secondary action is triggered.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Handler called when canceled.

props.name: isPrimaryActionDisabled
props.description: Whether the primary action button is disabled.

props.name: isSecondaryActionDisabled
props.description: Whether the secondary action button is disabled.

props.name: autoFocusButton
props.description: Which action button should receive initial focus.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the alert dialog.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the dialog is open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the dialog is open by default.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Handler called when open state changes.

props.name: isDismissible
props.description: Whether the dialog is dismissible. Alert dialogs default to false.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Alias for isDismissible, retained for older Solid Spectrum examples.

props.name: class
props.description: Additional CSS class name.
